question: What will be the ending value of the UST 10Y Yield for these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 23 - Dec 4)

calls.reasoning: Random-walk anchor at the Nov 20 close (~4.93%, per CNBC/MortgageDaily; FRED's last value is 5.04 on Nov 19). The move was driven by a safe-haven bid during an equity correction, while the Fed is hawkish (~92% odds of a Dec 9 hike; Waller floated 50bp). Catalysts are PCE on Nov 25, the 2Y/7Y auctions, and NFP on Dec 4 (resolution day), so volatility is elevated. Slight left skew in case the equity selloff deepens, offset by upside risk from hot PCE or a stock rebound. Kalshi year-end market (different date) reportedly favors 4.75-5.15, consistent with this.
calls.reference_class: 10-trading-day changes in DGS10 during the high-volatility Sep-Nov 2026 regime, centered on the latest close

calls.reasoning: Last close 4.92-4.93 on Nov 20 (Treasury par 4.92; FRED through Nov 19 at 5.04) after a 12bp safe-haven drop on an AI-equity selloff. Fed hike ~92% priced for December pushes up while risk-off pushes down, so roughly no drift and the median stays at the last close. About 9.5 trading days to Dec 4 including the Thanksgiving half-day, and the November jobs report likely lands on Dec 4. The current regime is high-vol (frequent 10-15bp days), so the 10-day SD is ~19bp. Kalshi year-end contract (different date, Dec 31) implies a median ~4.97 and P(>=4.75) ~80%, consistent. The 4.255 lower bound is ~3.4 SD away; tiny escape priced for a crash or flight to safety.

calls.reasoning: FRED DGS10 last printed 5.04 (Nov 19); Nov 20 closed ~4.93 (CNBC 4.932) after a 12bp flight-to-safety drop during an equity correction. The resolution value is the Dec 4 close, 9 trading days out, with PCE on Nov 25, the Thanksgiving holiday, and the November jobs report on Dec 4 itself. Fed hike odds near 92% for Dec 9 push yields up; the equity sell-off pulls them down, so the median is centred on the current level. Realized volatility since September is high: 9-day moves of 20-30bp are common. No escape mass: the 4.255 floor is more than 3.5 SD away.
